{{Top|leg}}
The '''Fest collaborationist government''' was the ruling body of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fest/Legends|Fest]]. They helped the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] oppress the people of the planet, and they were a constant target of the [[Fest Alliance Forces]]. The [[Fest police force]] were the government's most visible assets, and their constant targeting by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] forced the [[Fest military]] to take over their duties due to desertion.
